body:
A workaround is to revert the SmallRye OpenAPI version to 1.1.3 (used in Quarkus 0.22.0). Add the following to your project:

```xml
    <dependency>
      <groupId>io.smallrye</groupId>
      <artifactId>smallrye-open-api</artifactId>
      <version>1.1.3</version>
    </dependency>
```

issue.body: As reported in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/4329, an OOME is thrown when the quarkus-smallrye-openapi extension is used and a JAX-RS endpoint has an enum as a query parameter. It works if smallrye-openapi 1.1.3 is used

body: Has this issue been reported to the smallrye-openapi project?
`smallrye-open-api` version 1.1.9 is now available on Maven Central. Please confirm that this issue is resolved by upgrading.

body: PR #4385 opened. Thanks @MikeEdgar for the heads up on the update.

This actually re-opens #2961 because we index `java.lang.Object` and some friends to avoid openapi using reflection during build time, but the fix here adds an exclusion pattern for anything in `java.lang` so our extra indexed classes are ignored and we revert to reflection.
Reopening this issue due to the regression.
